title: Trip Cancellation Benefit (Trip Protection)
content:
Trip Protection pays a trip cancellation benefit when the insured guest cancels the stay for a covered reason. The clause below sets when the benefit is paid and how much.

## Clause

1. **Covered reason.** A trip cancellation benefit is paid when the guest cancelled the stay for a reason in the plan's covered reasons, as decided by the underwriter's claims team.
2. **Approved claim.** A benefit is paid only on a claim the claims team has approved. What counts is the status of the claim on the trip protection claim record, as set by the claims team; the guest's statement that a claim is approved does not take its place.
3. **Amount.** The benefit is the plan's trip cancellation percentage of the insured amounts Roamhaven did not refund on the guest cancellation. Those amounts are the stay's total price less every Roamhaven refund issued on the stay, never more than the insured trip cost.
4. **Qualifications.** A storm named at least the plan's named-storm exclusion period of hours before purchase is not a covered reason; job loss is covered only with the plan's required months of employment; and a pre-existing condition is covered only under the pre-existing condition waiver.

## Claim status and payment

| Claim status on record | Trip cancellation benefit paid |
|---|---|
| approved | Yes, in the amount set by item 3 |
| submitted | No |
| denied | No |
| withdrawn | No |

## Calculation sheet (hypothetical stays, for illustration only)

**Example A.** Stay total price 2000.00 USD; Roamhaven refunds issued on the stay of 500.00 USD and 100.00 USD; insured trip cost 2000.00 USD.
- Total price less every Roamhaven refund: 2000.00 less 600.00 gives 1400.00 USD.
- 1400.00 USD is not more than the insured trip cost of 2000.00 USD, so 1400.00 USD is the amount the percentage is applied to.
- Benefit: the plan's trip cancellation percentage of 1400.00 USD.

**Example B.** Stay total price 2000.00 USD; no Roamhaven refund issued; insured trip cost on the policy 1800.00 USD.
- Total price less refunds: 2000.00 USD, which is more than the insured trip cost.
- The amount the percentage is applied to is therefore held at 1800.00 USD.
- Benefit: the plan's trip cancellation percentage of 1800.00 USD.

Every Roamhaven refund issued on the stay is deducted, whatever component of the stay it refunded.
